selection_reason: Multi-component product: validated ingestion and token-cost accounting; search/reporting; optimistic concurrency, appends/finalization and branching lineage. Select for audit before seeing tests/reference, not on model scores.
audit_rejection_policy: Reject before paid inference if assertions conflict with supplied specs, dependent skips mask coverage, reference fails, baseline/collision controls pass, or fixture robustness fails. Preserve every rejected candidate.
